# Pinterest Canada

> A visual discovery platform where users curate and share boards of inspiration across art, fashion, home design, and fan communities.

Pinterest.ca hosts user-generated boards featuring diverse content from character design and fan art to fashion inspiration and home décor. The platform serves as a collaborative mood board and reference library for creative projects and personal interests.

## Key Topics

- Character Design
- Fan Art
- FPE (Fundamental Paper Education)
- Drawing References
- Fashion Inspiration
- Home Décor
- Knitting Patterns
- Portrait Drawing
- Animation Art
- Bedroom Style
- DIY Crafts
- Personal Collections
- Creative Inspiration

## Art & Character Design

- [Facial Anatomy and Portrait Drawing References](https://www.pinterest.ca/SpinyGrace7/рефересы-лица/): Curated facial anatomy and portrait drawing references for character design
- [Fundamental Paper Education Fan Art Collection](https://www.pinterest.ca/romanishinamargo15/fundamental-paper-education/): User-curated Pinterest board of Fundamental Paper Education fan art and character designs

## DIY & Crafts

- [Fuzzy Yarn Sweater Knitting Pattern Guide](https://www.pinterest.ca/pin/2023--566890671858765326/): DIY knitting pattern guide for fuzzy yarn sweater with cable-knit design

## Personal Style & Home

- [Home Photos and Pajama Fashion Inspiration](https://www.pinterest.ca/imlanayaroshenko/фото-дома-7-в-пижаме/): Personal Pinterest board featuring home photos and pajama fashion inspiration
